rationale: The original entry thesis relied on price remaining suppressed below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($170.68) and failing to hold $170.00, yet the last three 1-minute candles show buyers firmly defending the $170.00 psychological level and pushing price back above the 9-EMA to $171.07.
